prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "Learn quick mouse shortcuts and tray commands to manage your pet on screen.", "Right-click pet for main command menu", "Press Alt+P to instantly show or hide your pet", "Got It!"]
2: ["Meet Your New Companion", "Select a species and watch your pet animate live on stage before adopting.", "Select Species"]
3: ["Photo Quality Check", "We check your uploaded photo to guarantee optimal 3D pet generation.", "Upload Photo", "Tip: Use bright front lighting for best pet features"]
4: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Workspace", "Configuring tray widgets and desk animations. Almost ready!", "Tip: Double-click your desktop pet to open chat window."]
5: ["Protect Your Pet Data with Cloud Sync", "Sign in to back up your pet memory, customization, and progression to the cloud.", "Cloud Backup Secured", "Sign In to Sync"]
6: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Look down at your desktop screen or system tray icon.", "Pet missing? Click the pet icon in system tray or press Ctrl+Alt+P to summon."]
7: ["Adopt Your Desktop Companion in 2 Minutes", "Pick a pet to live on your screen, react to your day, and bring life to your workspace.", "Start Quick Setup"]
8: ["Building Desktop Graphics", "Feel free to use other apps. We will send a desktop alert when your pet is ready.", "Desktop Alert Active"]
9: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your companion is officially registered and bound to your computer screen.", "Welcome Pet to Desktop"]
